title: Herbal Gooey Algerian Vine Leaves Bake
description: A comforting, vegan-friendly baked dish featuring tender vine leaves, chickpeas, and a gooey blend of tomato and herbs.

ingredients.name: vine leaves
ingredients.notes: soaked in hot water for 5 minutes, drained

instructions: Rinse vine leaves and soak in hot water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet and sauté diced onion for 3 minutes until translucent.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in diced tomato and cook for 4 minutes until softened.
Mix in tomato paste and herb & spice blend; cook for 1 minute to combine flavors.
Add cooked chickpeas and lemon juice, stir well and simmer for 5 minutes.
Reduce heat and fold in shredded vegan cheese until melted and gooey.
Line a baking dish with vine leaves, spoon filling onto the leaves, then top with remaining vine leaves.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25 minutes or until the top is bubbly and golden.
Remove from oven, let rest for 5 minutes, then serve warm.
